about: StarCraft II's effect models (the .m3 files under Assets/Effects), described in our own words: each look was written by an agent from frames of the effect filmed in the game, attached to a Marine on plain ground (sc2-adjutant's effect tour), and says what it shows, how big it is next to the Marine, whether it follows a moving host and whether anything lingers after it is destroyed. Each model's path is the key that finds it in the game's data; nothing else here is extracted from the game. The pictures are in sc2-mapping-reference, under public/effects, at each model's path.

A small soft white glowing dot at the Marine's feet, well under the Marine's size. It stays steady and is gone once destroyed.

A bright white point inside a wide soft white haze that lights up the Marine and the ground around it, about two Marines across. It holds steady and is gone once destroyed.
